mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as borrowingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returnedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN deposit_status = 1 THEN deposit_amount ELSE 0 END) as totalDeposit, SUM(CASE WHEN deposit_status = 2 THEN deposit_amount ELSE 0 END) as refundedDeposit FROM borrow_order WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(deposit_amount) as depositAmount FROM borrow_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT bo.*, bi.name as borrower_name, bi.phone as borrower_phone, b.title as book_title, b.isbn as book_isbn FROM borrow_order bo LEFT JOIN borrower_info bi ON bo.borrower_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN book_info b ON bo.book_id = b.id WHERE bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.status = 0 AND bo.due_date < #{currentDate}
